description: Optional Base L2 anchor pointer for certified-mail equivalence. References an Anchored event from CheckpointAnchor.sol per ADR-2605171800. Per ADR-2605172200.

chain.description: EIP-155 chain ID. 8453 = Base mainnet; 84532 = Base Sepolia.

contract.description: 0x-prefixed CheckpointAnchor.sol contract address that emitted the Anchored event.

txHash.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte tx hash on the chain identified by `chain`.

mstRootCid.description: Multibase-encoded CIDv1 of the MST root that included this message at anchor time.

anchoredAt.description: Block timestamp when the Anchored event was emitted.
